This bearing belongs to the single direction thrust ball bearings, also called ball thrust bearings or axial deep groove ball bearings. These bearings consist of a shaft ring, a housing ring and a ball and cage assembly. Thrust ball bearings have an open design. The balls make them suitable for high rotational speeds. Single direction thrust ball bearings can only be loaded axially in one direction. A shaft can be locked in one direction this way. Radially, they must not be loaded. The shaft ring is attached to the shaft. This ring rotates along with the shaft. The housing ring has a slightly larger bore diameter, allowing the shaft to pass with some clearance. As thrust ball bearings can be disassembled, the components can easily be mounted separately. Be careful not to mix up the shaft and housing ring when you are assembling the bearing. This bearing cannot compensate for any misalignment between the shaft and housing.

This bearing belongs to the single direction thrust ball bearings, also called ball thrust bearings or axial deep groove ball bearings. These bearings consist of a shaft ring, a housing ring and a ball and cage assembly. Thrust ball bearings have an open design. The balls make them suitable for high rotational speeds. Single direction thrust ball bearings can only be loaded axially in one direction. A shaft can be locked in one direction this way. Radially, they must not be loaded. As thrust ball bearings can be disassembled, the components can easily be mounted separately. Be careful not to mix up the shaft and housing ring when you are assembling the bearing. The shaft ring is attached to the shaft. This ring rotates with the shaft. The housing ring has a slightly larger bore diameter, allowing the shaft to pass with some clearance.

This bearings belongs to the single direction thrust ball bearings, also called ball thrust bearings or axial deep groove ball bearings. These bearings consist of a shaft ring, a housing ring and a ball and cage assembly. Thrust ball bearings have an open design. The balls make them suitable for high rotational speeds. Single direction thrust ball bearings can only be loaded axially in one direction. A shaft can be locked in one direction this way. Radially, they must not be loaded. As thrust ball bearings can be disassembled, the components can easily be mounted separately. Be careful not to mix up the shaft and housing ring when you are assembling the bearing. The shaft ring is attached to the shaft. This ring rotates with the shaft. The housing ring has a slightly larger bore diameter, allowing the shaft to pass with some clearance. JR : Cage Comprising Two Flat Pressed Steel Washers, Ball Centered.

WASHER FOR NEEDLE ROLLER THRUST BEARING
tech: CP series is a thrust washer manufactured by Nadella, designed to be used in combination with a needle thrust bearing assembly. It is typically used in a complete assembly with a needle roller and cage assembly and potentially another thrust washer. It is a thin, flat, disc-shaped component designed to handle high axial loads in a compact space, typically used in conjunction with axial needle roller bearings to provide a hardened raceway. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (through-hardened). Features are : Precision Ground Surfaces, High Load Capacity in a Compact Design, Ease of Assembly, Minimal Space Requirement, High Stiffness, High Rigidity and Flatness, Reduced Friction, Cost-Effective Solution. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Machine Tool Spindles, Pumps and Compressors, Robotics, Steering Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Power Tools and General Mechanics.

It is a thin, flat, disc-shaped component designed to handle high axial loads in a compact space, typically used in conjunction with axial needle roller bearings to provide a hardened raceway. Features are : Precision Ground Surfaces, High Load Capacity in a Compact Design, Ease of Assembly, Minimal Space Requirement, High Stiffness, High Rigidity and Flatness, Reduced Friction, Cost-Effective Solution. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Machine Tool Spindles, Pumps and Compressors, Robotics, Steering Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Power Tools and General Mechanics.

The WS series is a specialized, high-precision shaft locating washer designed for use in cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearing assemblies. It is a separate component that facilitates easy mounting and centering in high-speed applications while being manufactured from durable bearing steel to handle significant axial loads. The WS bearing is to provide a hardened, precision-ground raceway surface for the rolling elements when the adjacent machine component (the shaft shoulder) is not suitable to act as a raceway. Material : It is manufactured from high-quality, through-hardened carbon chromium bearing steel. It is specifically a shaft locating washer (WS series), designed to be mounted on the shaft. It provides a hardened raceway surface in applications where the shaft itself is not suitable to act as one. Features are : Precision Tolerances, High Fatigue Resistance, Lightweight Design, Operating Temperature Range, High Load Capacity, Optimal for High Speeds. Applications : Machine Tools, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Robotics and Automation.

The WS bearing is to provide a hardened, precision-ground raceway surface for the rolling elements when the adjacent machine component (the shaft shoulder) is not suitable to act as a raceway. Material : It is manufactured from high-quality, through-hardened carbon chromium bearing steel. It is specifically a shaft locating washer (WS series), designed to be mounted on the shaft. It provides a hardened raceway surface in applications where the shaft itself is not suitable to act as one. Features are : Precision Tolerances, High Fatigue Resistance, Lightweight Design, Operating Temperature Range, High Load Capacity, Optimal for High Speeds. Applications : Machine Tools, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Robotics and Automation.

The GS series is a housing locating washer for cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearings, designed to provide a reliable raceway surface and secure axial positioning within a housing bore. It is not a complete bearing on its own but a component of a full thrust bearing assembly. It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. Features are : Compact Design Compatibility, High Rigidity, Optimal Load Distribution, Vibration Resistance, Reduced Wear and Tear, Low Maintenance. Applications : Automotive transmissions and steering systems, Gearbox assemblies, Machine tool drive shafts, Pumps and compressors, Heavy machinery and construction equipment.

The GS series is a housing locating washer for cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearings, designed to provide a reliable raceway surface and secure axial positioning within a housing bore. It is not a complete bearing on its own but a component of a full thrust bearing assembly. It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. It is a thin, flat, disc-shaped component designed to handle high axial loads in a compact space, typically used in conjunction with axial needle roller bearings to provide a hardened raceway. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (through-hardened). Features are : Precision Ground Surfaces, High Load Capacity in a Compact Design, Ease of Assembly, Minimal Space Requirement, High Stiffness, High Rigidity and Flatness, Reduced Friction, Cost-Effective Solution. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Machine Tool Spindles, Pumps and Compressors, Robotics, Steering Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Power Tools and General Mechanics.

The Nadella CPN series is a high-quality needle thrust washer or thrust plate designed for use in needle roller thrust bearing assemblies to handle significant axial loads. It is a single, flat, hardened steel ring with a heavy section designed to withstand high pressure and shock loads without significant deformation. This washer serves as a robust raceway surface for a separate needle roller and cage assembly, enabling smooth rotation and transmission of heavy axial (thrust) forces. Material : Made from high-quality bearing steel that has been hardened and polished, ensuring durability and a long service life even under demanding operating conditions. Features are : High Axial Load Capacity, Heavy-Duty Construction, Low Friction, Durability and shock resistance, Ease of installation, High Rigidity, Heat Stabilization, Space-Saving Solution. Applications : Compressors and Turbines, Material Handling, Printing Presses, Metallurgical Machinery, Textile Machinery, Machine Tools, Rack and Pinion Systems, Pumps and Hydraulic Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Machine Tools.

This washer serves as a robust raceway surface for a separate needle roller and cage assembly, enabling smooth rotation and transmission of heavy axial (thrust) forces. Material : Made from high-quality bearing steel that has been hardened and polished, ensuring durability and a long service life even under demanding operating conditions. Features are : High Axial Load Capacity, Heavy-Duty Construction, Low Friction, Durability and shock resistance, Ease of installation, High Rigidity, Heat Stabilization, Space-Saving Solution. Applications : Compressors and Turbines, Material Handling, Printing Presses, Metallurgical Machinery, Textile Machinery, Machine Tools, Rack and Pinion Systems, Pumps and Hydraulic Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Machine Tools.

The Nadella CPNT series is a thrust plate used as a component within a larger needle roller thrust bearing or a combined bearing assembly. It is designed to provide a hardened, precision raceway for needle rollers to run against, specifically for applications supporting heavy axial (thrust) loads. The CPNT52035 plate provides a robust and precise contact surface for the needle rollers, allowing for the smooth transmission of heavy axial loads. This is essential for applications where the surrounding components of the machine are not hardened or machined to serve as a proper raceway. It is designed to work as part of a complete bearing assembly. Material : Made from high-quality chrome/bearing steel, it offers high durability, resistance to wear, and reliable performance in a wide range of operating temperatures (typically -20°C to +120°C).Features are : High Precision Raceway, Accommodates Heavy Axial Loads, Space-Saving Design, Easy Installation, Compatibility, Optimized Surface Finish, High Rigidity, Wear Resistance. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes, Machine Tools, Automotive Systems, Printing and Textile Machinery, Pumps and Compressors, Agricultural Machines, Conveyor Systems.

The Nadella CPR series is a thrust bearing washer (or thrust plate/friction washer) used as a component in a complete needle roller thrust bearing assembly. It is a hardened steel ring designed to provide a raceway for the rolling elements and support axial loads. The washer is a crucial part of a thrust bearing assembly. It acts as one of the raceways for the needle or roller elements, distributing axial loads evenly between the bearing and the adjacent machine components (shaft and housing). Material : The washer is made from through-hardened bearing steel (typically carbon chromium steel), which provides the necessary hardness and strength to withstand high loads and prevent surface fatigue. Features are : Precision Tolerances, Cost-Effectiveness, Ease of Installation, Axial Load Management, High Load Capacity, Minimized Friction and Wear. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Pumps and Compressors, Machine Tools, Construction and Mining Machinery, Agricultural Machinery, Marine Propulsion Systems, Conveyor Systems, Power Generation.

The Nadella CPT series is a thin-series thrust plate used as a precision raceway in axial needle roller and axial cylindrical roller bearing assemblies. It is not a complete bearing on its own but is a critical component for applications with high axial loads. When used with a needle roller and cage assembly, this thrust plate allows the bearing to support high axial loads in a minimal axial space. Material : Made from high-quality hardened roller bearing steel for durability. The CPT series is an open component with no seals, which means it relies on external lubrication from the application. Features are : High Axial Load Capacity, Space Efficient Design, Ease of Assembly, Fatigue Life, Space Efficient Design. Applications : Automatic transmissions and torque converters, Power steering systems, Construction equipment, Hydraulic systems, Mining and agricultural machinery, Marine machinery, Machine tools, Pumps and compressors, Wind turbines, Power transmission systems.

The K811-TV-A/0-8 series is an axial cylindrical roller and cage assembly, part of the 811 series which conforms to DIN 722/ISO 104 standards. This bearing component is designed to handle high axial and shock loads in one direction. The K811-TV-A/0-8 bearing is a roller assembly only, designed to be combined with separate shaft locating washers (WS81109) and housing locating washers (GS81109), or can run directly on adjacent machine components if the surfaces are suitably prepared as raceways. Material : The cylindrical rollers are made of standard rolling bearing steel with injection-moulded cage made of Polyamide 66 (PA66). Features are : High Axial Load Capacity, High Rigidity, Insensitivity to Shock Loads, Reduced Friction, Separable Components, Lightweight. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Material Handling Equipment, Machine Tools, Pumps and Compressors, Automotive Systems, Metal Processing, Power Generation. TV=Polyamide Cage, A=Internal Design, 0-8=Micron - Needle Sort.

The INA K811-M/+6-8 bearing is an axial cylindrical roller and cage assembly designed for high load-bearing capacity in a single axial direction, often used in space-constrained applications. The K811-M/+6-8 bearing assembly accommodates heavy axial loads and peak loads but is not designed for radial loads. Its separable design means it is typically used with adjacent machine components serving as raceways, or it can be combined with separate G81140 housing and W81140 shaft washers to form a complete bearing. Material : Made from standard bearing steel with a machined brass cage, ensuring durability and reliable performance. Features are : High Axial Load Capacity, High Stiffness, Space Efficient, Reduced Friction, Low Noise, High Temperature Performance, Precision Tolerance, Lubrication Efficiency. Applications : Industrial Transmissions and Gearboxes, Machine Tools, Material Handling Equipment, Pumps and Compressors, Marine and Offshore, Hydraulic Motors, Paper Industry, Steel Mills, Wind Power. M=Machined Brass Cage, Located On The Rolling Elements, +6-8=Micron - Needle Sort.

The GS series is a housing locating washer for cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearings, designed to provide a reliable raceway surface and secure axial positioning within a housing bore. It is not a complete bearing on its own but a component of a full thrust bearing assembly. It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. Features are : Compact Design Compatibility, High Rigidity, Optimal Load Distribution, Vibration Resistance, Reduced Wear and Tear, Low Maintenance. Applications : Automotive transmissions and steering systems, Gearbox assemblies, Machine tool drive shafts, Pumps and compressors, Heavy machinery and construction equipment.

The AR series is a single-direction roller thrust bearing designed for heavy axial loads in high-precision industrial applications. The AR93060 is a complete axial cylindrical roller bearing with incorporated thrust plates. The rolling elements (cylindrical rollers) are retained and guided in radial pockets within a robust steel cage. This assembly is easy to handle and install. Material : Constructed from through-hardened or case-hardened bearing steel to ensure required hardness and durability. Features are : Self-Centering Action, Installation Versatility, High Rigidity, High Axial Load Capacity, High Stiffness in Small Footprint, Minimal Friction Coefficient. Applications : Machine Tools, Automation and Robotics, Printing and Packaging, Textile Machinery, Pumps and Compressors, Automotive Components, Aerospace and Marine, Material Handling, Medical and Laboratory Equipment.

The ARZ bearing is a thrust cylindrical roller bearing from the light series, with standard dimensions and a design that helps retain lubricant and protect against dirt. It is an axial cage system with cylindrical rollers and includes thick, hardened thrust washers which are held together by a cap or steel ring. This integrated design provides protection against dirt entry and helps in retaining the lubricant. Material : The bearing is made from standard bearing steel. The cage type is typically steel or a standard cage. These bearings are designed to support high axial loads. The cylindrical roller design, as opposed to needle rollers, allows for distributing strain on a wide contact surface. Features are : Contaminant Protection, Space-Saving Profile, Low Friction, Self-Centering Capability, Flexible Alignment, Shock and Fatigue Resistance, High Speed Capability, High Stiffness, Easy-to-Install Assembly. Applications : Industrial Gearboxes & Transmissions, Automation & Robotics, Packaging Machinery, Printing Presses, Machine Tools, Automotive Systems, Marine & Heavy Industry.

These bearing is a single-direction cylindrical roller thrust bearing designed to handle very heavy axial loads and impact loads. It is a separable bearing, meaning its components (shaft washer, housing washer, and roller and cage assembly) can be mounted separately. The bearing is separable, which simplifies mounting. Its primary components are the cylindrical roller and cage assembly, a shaft washer (WS), and a housing washer (GS). The raceway surfaces on the washers are precision-machined to ensure proper load distribution. Material : The components are typically made from high carbon chromium steel. Features are : Accommodation of Heavy Loads, Ease of Mounting, High Stiffness, Compact Axial Space, Operating Temperature Range, No Self-Alignment Capability, Optimized Raceway Surfaces. Applications : Metalworking Equipment, Machine Tools, Oil & Mining Equipment, Energy Generation, Marine & Offshore, Mining and Construction Machinery, Steel Industry.

The F-4346.04.ZARI bearing is a high-precision, cylindrical roller thrust bearing, expertly engineered by INA to manage heavy axial (thrust) loads in demanding industrial applications, specifically within Heidelberg offset printing machines. It is an axial (thrust) cylindrical roller bearing, meaning its primary function is to support forces acting parallel to the axis of rotation. The design features cylindrical rollers arranged between flat raceway washers, which provides a large contact area and high stiffness. This specific model is often supplied as a five-piece set, including two roller and cage thrust assemblies, two shaft washers, and one housing washer, for a complete and precise installation. Material: The bearing is manufactured from high-quality chrome steel. Features are : High Precision Rating, Insensitivity to Shock Loads, Space Efficient Design, Long Service Life, Compact Axial Height, Easy Maintenance. Applications : Paper Feeding Systems, Roller Movement Mechanisms, General Printing Machine Power Transmission, Material Handling Equipment, Pumps and Compressors, Steel Manufacturing and Rolling Mills. ZARI=Assembly Configuration.

The AR bearing is a single-direction axial cylindrical roller bearing with separable components designed to handle very high axial and shock loads in one direction, while requiring minimal axial space. The AR series is a complete axial cylindrical roller bearing unit, which includes a single row of rollers held in a sheet steel cage, and accompanying washers. Its design allows the individual parts (shaft washer, housing washer, and roller/cage assembly) to be fitted separately, which simplifies both mounting and maintenance inspections. Material: Standard bearing steel. Features are : Superior Rigidity, High Load Handling, Space-Saving Profile. Applications : Industrial Machinery, Automatic Machinery, Machine Tools, Power Transmission, Space-Constrained Designs, Agricultural Machinery, Textile Machinery, Compressors and Turbines, Material Handling Equipment.

The \"AX\" series, it is designed for higher rigidity and load-carrying capacity compared to thinner standard assemblies. Rollers are slightly relieved towards their outer edges to ensure uniform load distribution and prevent damage from \"edge loading\" during operation. Features are : High Rigidity & Capacity, Compact Load Handling, Reduced Maintenance, Low Friction. Applications : Transmissions & Gearboxes, Conveyor Systems, Machine Tools, Packaging & Textile Machinery, Robotics & Automation, Medical Equipment, Power Tools, Mechanical Pumps and Compressors.

CP series is a thrust washer manufactured by Nadella, designed to be used in combination with a needle thrust bearing assembly. It is typically used in a complete assembly with a needle roller and cage assembly and potentially another thrust washer. It is a thin, flat, disc-shaped component designed to handle high axial loads in a compact space, typically used in conjunction with axial needle roller bearings to provide a hardened raceway. Material : High-carbon chromium bearing steel (through-hardened). Features are : Precision Ground Surfaces, High Load Capacity in a Compact Design, Ease of Assembly, Minimal Space Requirement, High Stiffness, High Rigidity and Flatness, Reduced Friction, Cost-Effective Solution. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Machine Tool Spindles, Pumps and Compressors, Robotics, Steering Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Power Tools and General Mechanics.

These bearing is a single-direction thrust ball bearing manufactured by RHP. This high-precision bearing is composed of a three-piece assembly, including a shaft washer, a housing washer, and a ball-and-cage assembly. Material : It is made of through-hardened premium chrome steel (SAE 52100) paired with a heavy-duty machined brass cage for high strength and low friction. Features are : Easy Installation, High Structural Strength, Low Friction & Heat, Vibration Dampening, High Axial Capacity, Zero Radial Capability, Fatigue Resistance, Simplified Maintenance Mechanics, Shock Absorption, Super-Finished Raceways, High Rigidity Under Load, Low Starting Torque, Thermal & Speed Stability. Applications : Fluid Handling and Pumping Systems, Power Transmission and Gearboxes, Power Generation & Energy Systems, Metal Processing & Heavy Manufacturing, Drilling & Mining Machinery, Processing Equipment & Chemicals, Machine Tool Rotary Tables. M=Machined Brass Cage.

These bearing is a complete, single-direction axial cylindrical roller thrust bearing, designed to accommodate very heavy axial loads but no radial loads. It has a separable design, which simplifies mounting by allowing the components (the roller and cage assembly, shaft washer, and housing washer) to be installed separately. Material : It is made from normal bearing steel, and the rollers are held by a polyamide molded cage. Features are : High Load Capacity, High Stiffness, Open Design, Reduced Maintenance Costs, High Rigidity, Damping & Low Noise, Compact & Separable Design, Shock Load Resistance. Applications : Machine Tools, Gearboxes and Transmissions, Pumps and Compressors, Material Handling Systems, Power Generation, Electric Tools, Agricultural Machinery, Assembly Lines and Conveyors. TV=Polyamide Cage.

The GS series is a housing locating washer for cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearings, designed to provide a reliable raceway surface and secure axial positioning within a housing bore. It is not a complete bearing on its own but a component of a full thrust bearing assembly. It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. Features are : Compact Design Compatibility, High Rigidity, Optimal Load Distribution, Vibration Resistance, Reduced Wear and Tear, Low Maintenance. Applications : Automotive transmissions and steering systems, Gearbox assemblies, Machine tool drive shafts, Pumps and compressors, Heavy machinery and construction equipment.

This bearings belongs to the single direction thrust ball bearings, also called ball thrust bearings or axial deep groove ball bearings. These bearings consist of a shaft ring, a housing ring and a ball and cage assembly. Thrust ball bearings have an open design. The balls make them suitable for high rotational speeds. Single direction thrust ball bearings can only be loaded axially in one direction. A shaft can be locked in one direction this way. Radially, they must not be loaded. The shaft ring is attached to the shaft. This ring rotates along with the shaft. The housing ring has a slightly larger bore diameter, allowing the shaft to pass with some clearance. As thrust ball bearings can be disassembled, the components can easily be mounted separately. Be careful not to mix up the shaft and housing ring when you are assembling the bearing. This bearing cannot compensate for any misalignment between the shaft and housing. MP : Solid Brass Window Cage, Ball Guided.

They consist of two rows of balls that are placed at an angle to each other. This design allows the bearing to support both axial and radial loads at the same time, making it ideal for use in machines that require both types of support. One of the main benefits of using this type of bearing is that it helps to reduce friction and wear between moving parts.

Shaft Locating Washers are precision components designed to provide axial positioning and support in rotary or linear applications. They provide an effective solution for retaining bearings and minimizing axial movement, contributing to enhanced operational stability and longevity.

This bearing belongs to the single direction thrust ball bearings, also called ball thrust bearings or axial deep groove ball bearings. Single direction thrust ball bearings can only be loaded axially in one direction. A shaft can be locked in one direction this way. Radially, they must not be loaded. Single row cylindrical roller thrust bearings are designed to accommodate heavy axial loads and peak loads in one direction, but not radial loads. desc: WASHER FOR NEEDLE ROLLER THRUST BEARING
tech: Thin universal washers for needle roller thrust bearings are supplied as separate components. They are made of spring steel and hardened, and both faces of the washers are polished and can be used as raceways. The washers can provide cost-effective solutions, if the adjacent machine components are not hardened, but have adequate stiffness, and the requirements to run-out are moderate. They can be used as shaft or housing washers for AXK series bearings, and as shaft washers for AXW series bearings. Features are : Enable full interchangeability of washers, Require minimal axial space, Provide cost-effective solutions, Simplified installation. Applications : Machine tools, Conveying equipment and robotics, Automotive industry, Steering systems, Construction equipment, General mechanical systems.

They are made of spring steel and hardened, and both faces of the washers are polished and can be used as raceways. The washers can provide cost-effective solutions, if the adjacent machine components are not hardened, but have adequate stiffness, and the requirements to run-out are moderate. They can be used as shaft or housing washers for AXK series bearings, and as shaft washers for AXW series bearings. Features are : Enable full interchangeability of washers, Require minimal axial space, Provide cost-effective solutions, Simplified installation. Applications : Machine tools, Conveying equipment and robotics, Automotive industry, Steering systems, Construction equipment, General mechanical systems.

The AX series is a precision-engineered metric axial needle roller thrust bearing designed for high-load applications where axial space is severely restricted. It belongs to Nadella\\\'s \\\"AX\\\" thick series, which features a robust cage design to guide a large quantity of needle rollers. Material : Standard bearing steel with sheet steel cage. The \\\"AX\\\" series, it is designed for higher rigidity and load-carrying capacity compared to thinner standard assemblies. Rollers are slightly relieved towards their outer edges to ensure uniform load distribution and prevent damage from \\\"edge loading\\\" during operation. Features are : High Rigidity & Capacity, Compact Load Handling, Reduced Maintenance, Low Friction. Applications : Transmissions & Gearboxes, Conveyor Systems, Machine Tools, Packaging & Textile Machinery, Robotics & Automation, Medical Equipment, Power Tools, Mechanical Pumps and Compressors.

Needle roller and cage thrust assemblies are designed to accommodate heavy axial loads and peak loads in one direction. They provide a high degree of stiffness within a minimum axial space. In applications where the faces of adjacent machine components serve as raceways, needle roller thrust bearings take up no more space than a conventional thrust washer. The bearings can also be combined with bearing washers to create complete bearings. Features are : High axial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, Long service life, Require minimal axial space, Can be combined with bearing washers.

The Nadella AXL100135 is a high-precision, metric axial needle roller thrust bearing from the Nadella \"Thick\" series. It is engineered to handle heavy axial loads in applications with minimal space, featuring a single-row needle cage with a built-in thick washer. Material : Standard high-quality bearing steel with a sheet steel cage. The needle rollers are slightly relieved toward their outer edges, ensuring uniform load distribution and protecting the bearing from damage caused by \"edge loading\" during high-stress operations. Features are : Modified Roller Profile, Single-Direction Support, High Rigidity & Capacity, Low Friction Performance, Temperature Stability, Compact Footprint, Self-Centering Action, Thermal and Operational Stability. Applications : Transmissions and Gearboxes, Pumps and Compressors, Material Handling, Machine Tools, Textile Machinery, Packaging Equipment, Medical Equipment, Automotive Systems, Agricultural Machinery.

Needle roller thrust bearings are designed to accommodate heavy axial loads and peak loads in one direction. They provide a high degree of stiffness within a minimum axial space. The bearings consist of a needle roller and cage thrust assembly and a thrust washer with a centring flange. The flange facilitates mounting and accurately centres the washer radially. To accommodate combined radial and axial loads, the bearings can be combined with drawn cup needle roller bearings or needle roller bearings with machined rings. Features are : High axial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, Long service life, Require minimal axial space, Separable design.

The Nadella CPR series is a thrust bearing washer (or thrust plate/friction washer) used as a component in a complete needle roller thrust bearing assembly. It is a hardened steel ring designed to provide a raceway for the rolling elements and support axial loads. The washer is a crucial part of a thrust bearing assembly. It acts as one of the raceways for the needle or roller elements, distributing axial loads evenly between the bearing and the adjacent machine components (shaft and housing). Material : The washer is made from through-hardened bearing steel (typically carbon chromium steel), which provides the necessary hardness and strength to withstand high loads and prevent surface fatigue. Features are : Precision Tolerances, Cost-Effectiveness, Ease of Installation, Axial Load Management, High Load Capacity, Minimized Friction and Wear. Applications : Gearboxes and Transmissions, Pumps and Compressors, Machine Tools, Construction and Mining Machinery, Agricultural Machinery, Marine Propulsion Systems, Conveyor Systems, Power Generation.

The GS series is a housing locating washer for cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearings, designed to provide a reliable raceway surface and secure axial positioning within a housing bore. It is not a complete bearing on its own but a component of a full thrust bearing assembly. It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. Features are : Compact Design Compatibility, High Rigidity, Optimal Load Distribution, Vibration Resistance, Reduced Wear and Tear, Low Maintenance. Applications : Automotive transmissions and steering systems, Gearbox assemblies, Machine tool drive shafts, Pumps and compressors, Heavy machinery and construction equipment.

It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. Features are : Compact Design Compatibility, High Rigidity, Optimal Load Distribution, Vibration Resistance, Reduced Wear and Tear, Low Maintenance. Applications : Automotive transmissions and steering systems, Gearbox assemblies, Machine tool drive shafts, Pumps and compressors, Heavy machinery and construction equipment.

The GS series is a housing locating washer for cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearings, designed to provide a reliable raceway surface and secure axial positioning within a housing bore. It is not a complete bearing on its own but a component of a full thrust bearing assembly. It is precisely machined and ground to ensure high running accuracy, durability, and resistance to deformity under heavy axial loads. This washer serves as a raceway surface for the rolling elements in applications where adjacent machine components cannot serve this purpose. It helps secure and position the full bearing assembly axially within the housing, preventing it from slipping or shifting during operation. These bearing is a typically combined with a roller and cage thrust assembly and a corresponding shaft washer to form a complete thrust bearing. Features are : Compact Design Compatibility, High Rigidity, Optimal Load Distribution, Vibration Resistance, Reduced Wear and Tear, Low Maintenance. Applications : Automotive transmissions and steering systems, Gearbox assemblies, Machine tool drive shafts, Pumps and compressors, Heavy machinery and construction equipment.

The WS series is a specialized, high-precision shaft locating washer designed for use in cylindrical and needle roller thrust bearing assemblies. It is a separate component that facilitates easy mounting and centering in high-speed applications while being manufactured from durable bearing steel to handle significant axial loads. The WS bearing is to provide a hardened, precision-ground raceway surface for the rolling elements when the adjacent machine component (the shaft shoulder) is not suitable to act as a raceway. Material : It is manufactured from high-quality, through-hardened carbon chromium bearing steel. It is specifically a shaft locating washer (WS series), designed to be mounted on the shaft. It provides a hardened raceway surface in applications where the shaft itself is not suitable to act as one. Features are : Precision Tolerances, High Fatigue Resistance, Lightweight Design, Operating Temperature Range, High Load Capacity, Optimal for High Speeds. Applications : Machine Tools, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Robotics and Automation.

The WS bearing is to provide a hardened, precision-ground raceway surface for the rolling elements when the adjacent machine component (the shaft shoulder) is not suitable to act as a raceway. Material : It is manufactured from high-quality, through-hardened carbon chromium bearing steel. It is specifically a shaft locating washer (WS series), designed to be mounted on the shaft. It provides a hardened raceway surface in applications where the shaft itself is not suitable to act as one. Features are : Precision Tolerances, High Fatigue Resistance, Lightweight Design, Operating Temperature Range, High Load Capacity, Optimal for High Speeds. Applications : Machine Tools, Material Handling, Renewable Energy, Agricultural Machinery, Industrial Gearboxes and Transmissions, Robotics and Automation.

The NTB is a standard-grade, metric-series thrust needle roller bearing designed exclusively for unidirectional high-load axial engineering configurations. It features an ultra-low cross-section profile, serving as a specialized design option for environments constrained by compact spacing requirements. Material : Hardened carbon-chromium bearing steel rolling elements held within a surface-hardened, press-formed steel cage matrix. Features are : Axial Power Density, High Load-Carrying Capacity, High-Speed Kinematics, Reduced Sliding Friction, Low Roughness Tolerance, High Vibration Damping, Logarithmic Roller Crowning, Low Starting Torque, High Structural Stiffness, Operating Temperature. Applications : Automotive & Drivetrain Systems, Fluid Power & Hydraulic Machinery, Aerospace & Marine Systems, Medical & Laboratory Equipment, Energy & Power Generation, Agricultural Seed Drills.
